whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Underground Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.3★ reviews across 500+ locals on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and food menus.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular food menu categories, aur gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/underground

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi The Underground Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (The Underground Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a mobile-first menu showcase and direct WhatsApp table booking for Boring Road customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual interior photos aur pricing setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
